    """Extract gen0-gen10 eff_rank from any format."""
    metrics = exp.get("metrics", {})
    extra = exp.get("extra", {})
    eff = {}
    
    # Special case: exp_001 uses phase0_results.json
    if exp_id == "exp_001":
        return phase0_by_gen
    
    # Format 1: flat keys gen0_eff_rank ... gen10_eff_rank
    for g in range(11):
        key = f"gen{g}_eff_rank"
        if key in metrics:
            eff[g] = metrics[key]
    
    # Format 2: per_gen in metrics
    per_gen = metrics.get("per_gen", None)
    if per_gen and isinstance(per_gen, dict):
        for g in range(11):
            gkey = f"gen{g}"
            if gkey in per_gen and isinstance(per_gen[gkey], dict):
                if "eff_rank" in per_gen[gkey]:
                    eff[g] = per_gen[gkey]["eff_rank"]
    
    # Format 3: gen0, gen1, etc directly in metrics (nested dicts)
    for g in range(11):
        gkey = f"gen{g}"
        if gkey in metrics and isinstance(metrics[gkey], dict):
            if "eff_rank" in metrics[gkey]:
                eff[g] = metrics[gkey]["eff_rank"]
    
    return eff

    metrics = exp.get("metrics", {})
    
    # Direct type field
    if "type" in metrics:
        t = metrics["type"]
        if t in ("I", "II", "III"):
            return f"Type {t}"
        return str(t)
    
    if "slv_trajectory" in metrics:
        s = metrics["slv_trajectory"]
        if "dip" in s.lower():
            return "Type II"
        if "monotonic" in s.lower():
            return "Type I"
        return s[:30]
    
    # Infer from trend text
    trend = metrics.get("trend", "")
    if "Type I" in trend: return "Type I"
    if "Type II" in trend: return "Type II"
    if "Type III" in trend: return "Type III"
    
    # For type_ii_supported
    if metrics.get("type_ii_supported"):
        return "Type II"
    
    return None

]

    vals = []

    rr_str = f"{rr}" if not isinstance(rr, str) else rr
    ttype_str = ttype if ttype else "---"
    status = exp.get("status", "?")

    if notes:

    print(f"{eid:>10} | {rr_str:>8} | {seed:>4} | {' '.join(vals)} | {ttype_str:>10} | {notes_str}")
